propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes resolved-status names instead of reading from config, unlike the DC reconciler which reads from ReconcilerConfig.resolved_statuses, causing tenants with custom workflow status names to misclassify issues as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED

JiraConfig must expose resolved_statuses as a configurable list[str] field defaulting to ['Resolved', 'Done', 'Cancelled'] with _as_str_list coercion and auto-derived REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES env override

probe.classify_probe_response must resolve the status set from config at runtime via _resolve_resolved_statuses(), falling back to module-level RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES when the configured list is unset, empty, or malformed

custom resolved_statuses config such as ['Closed', 'Complete'] causes those custom statuses to classify as PRESENT_RESOLVED while default statuses like 'Done' classify as PRESENT_FILTERED under the same config
an explicitly empty jira.resolved_statuses list must fall back to the module default rather than bind an empty frozenset, preserving backward compatibility for stock tenants
